features.title: Ranked @ mentions for files and threads
features.summary: One @ menu that interleaves files and threads by match quality (exact title or basename, prefix, substring or fuzzy), then recency, then workspace or project, hides blank threads, and narrows with @thread: / @t: or @file: / @f:. Picks insert the native reference chips.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Seed a mention target"
fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "@t:"
failureModes: A failed Host lookup drops that kind of candidate and keeps the other one.
A quoted path cannot keep its scope prefix through a drill, so it continues as a plain @ mention.
